cases.pg: disagree: PostgreSQL accepts a per-row delimiter; DuckDB rejects a non-constant separator

cases.pg: disagree: PostgreSQL DESC defaults to NULLS FIRST; DuckDB to NULLS LAST

cases.pg: agree in SQL: peers have no defined order in either engine
